period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary half-yearly interim financial statements ("Half Yearly Report 2014", statements for the half year ended 30 June 2014 (Unaudited)). This copy is a scanned booklet (cover letter + individually paginated statement pages, page numbers 07-10 visible) rather than a native-text PDF; figures were read visually from high-resolution crops of the relevant pages. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2014 (Unaudited)' / 'Profit and Loss Account for the half year ended 30 June 2014 (Unaudited)') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 144,588.15m + Total equity 19,125.31m = Total assets 163,713.45m exactly; every P&L subtotal from Total operating income (5,286.24m) down to Net profit before tax (1,889.77m) reconciles exactly. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in this primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap.
